title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo
tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

judge.summary: A clean, simple green sprout sits above the clearly readable shop name on a plain white square background, matching the request.

must_haves.why: The name is correctly spelled and prominently displayed in legible green lettering.

must_haves.item: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
must_haves.why: A minimal green outline of a two-leaf sprout is centered above the text.
The background is white with no scenery, patterns, or additional elements.

must_haves.item: The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.
must_haves.why: The square image shows only a flat sprout symbol and typography.
